name: Interim Measures for the Management of Artificial Intelligence Anthropomorphic Interactive Services
description: World's first dedicated national regulation governing emotionally interactive and companion AI services simulating human personality, voice, or emotional attachment across text, audio, image, and video.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Cyberspace Administration of China (cac.gov.cn).
